	if Toggles.AutoEquipTrail.Value and TrailSettings and equipped then
		local bestName, bestOrder = nil, -1
		if owned then
			for _, entry in ipairs(owned:GetChildren()) do
				if entry.Value == true then
					local config = TrailSettings.Get(entry.Name)
					local order = config and config.Order or 0
					if order > bestOrder then
						bestName, bestOrder = entry.Name, order
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if bestName and equipped.Value ~= bestName then
			TrailsRemote:FireServer("Select", bestName)
			task.wait(0.2)
		end
	end
end

local function doAutoBarbell()
	if not Toggles.AutoBarbell.Value or not BarbellUpgrades or not BarbellUpgrades.GetNext then return end
	if os.clock() - LastBarbellAction < 3 then return end
	LastBarbellAction = os.clock()

	local level = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("BarbellLevel")
	if not level then return end

	local nextUpgrade = BarbellUpgrades.GetNext(math.max(math.floor(tonumber(level.Value) or 1), 1))
	if not nextUpgrade then return end
	if getCash() < (tonumber(nextUpgrade.CashPrice) or 0) then return end

	local plot     = getPlot()
	local zone     = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("SquatZone")
	local upgradeB = zone and zone:FindFirstChild("UpgradeB")
	local prompt   = upgradeB and upgradeB:FindFirstChild("BarbellUpgradePrompt", true)
	if not prompt or not prompt.Enabled then return end

	local position = holderPosition(prompt.Parent)
	if position then
		teleportTo(position)
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
	fireproximityprompt(prompt)
	task.wait(0.4)
end

local function findMutationPet(targetName)
	local candidate, candidateCps
	forEachContainer(function(container)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if isPetTool(child) then
				local name = child:GetAttribute("AnimalName") or child.Name
				local cps  = tonumber(child:GetAttribute("CashPerSecond")) or math.huge
				if name == targetName and (not candidateCps or cps < candidateCps) then
					candidate, candidateCps = child, cps
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	return candidate
end

local function findDuplicateAnimal()
	local counts, lowest = {}, {}
	forEachContainer(function(container)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if isPetTool(child) then
				local name = child:GetAttribute("AnimalName") or child.Name
				local cps  = tonumber(child:GetAttribute("CashPerSecond")) or math.huge
				counts[name] = (counts[name] or 0) + 1
				if not lowest[name] or cps < lowest[name] then lowest[name] = cps end
			end
		end
	end)

	local bestName, bestCps
	for name, count in pairs(counts) do
		if count >= 2 and (not bestCps or lowest[name] < bestCps) then
			bestName, bestCps = name, lowest[name]
		end
	end
	return bestName
end

local function mutationDetector()
	local map       = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local mutations = map and map:FindFirstChild("Mutations")
	return mutations and mutations:FindFirstChild("Detector") or nil
end

local function fireMutation(name, detector)
	local prompt = detector and detector:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	if not prompt or not prompt.Enabled then return false end

	local position = holderPosition(prompt.Parent)
	if position then
		teleportTo(position)
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	fireproximityprompt(prompt)
	task.wait(0.35)
	return true
end

local function doAutoMutation()
	local active    = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MutationCraftActive") == true
	local ready     = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MutationCraftReady") == true
	local canRemove = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MutationCanRemove") == true
	local detector  = mutationDetector()

	if Toggles.AutoClaimMutation.Value and active and ready then
		fireMutation("MutationPrompt", detector)
		return
	end

	if Toggles.AutoReturnMutation.Value and active and canRemove then
		fireMutation("MutationRemovePrompt", detector)
		return
	end

	if not Toggles.AutoAddMutation.Value or active then return end

	local target = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MutationCraftAnimalName")
	if type(target) ~= "string" or target == "" then
		if Options.MutationMode and Options.MutationMode.Value == "Chosen Animal" then
			target = Options.MutationAnimal and Options.MutationAnimal.Value
		else
			target = findDuplicateAnimal()
		end
	end
	if not target or target == "None" then return end

	local tool = findMutationPet(target)
	if not tool then return end

	local humanoid = getHumanoid()
	if not humanoid then return end

	pcall(function() humanoid:EquipTool(tool) end)
	task.wait(0.2)
	fireMutation("MutationPrompt", detector)
end

	task.spawn(function()

		end
	end)
end

scripts.features:
The AI behaves like an aggressive, predictive sword fighter.

It constantly searches for the nearest living opponent and follows them as its main target.

Instead of simply moving toward the opponent's current position, it watches how the opponent is moving and estimates their velocity and acceleration. It uses that information to predict where the opponent will be shortly, then moves and aims toward that predicted position.

The AI tries to avoid moving in a completely straight line. It constantly changes its footwork using randomized behaviors such as strafing, circling, moving behind the opponent, moving to the side, moving diagonally, briefly hesitating, spinning, jumping, and suddenly changing direction.

It has preferred attack-positioning behaviors. It often tries to get behind or beside the opponent instead of staying directly in front of them. Its preferred position is randomized, so its movement does not always look identical.

The AI watches the opponent's movement and can react when the opponent suddenly slows down, changes direction, or turns. When this happens, it can temporarily change its movement pattern or reposition to another side.

It also checks the surrounding space using directional sensing. This lets it determine which directions have more room and which directions are obstructed. It combines this information with its desired direction so it does not blindly move toward the opponent when that direction is unsafe or blocked.

For aiming and facing, the AI does more than simply look directly at the opponent. It evaluates several nearby possible directions and recursively compares them for a short distance into the future. It prefers directions that keep the opponent in front of it, maintain useful positioning, have better clearance, and fit its current movement.

Its turning is smoothed rather than instantly snapping toward the target. This makes its aim continuously adjust as the opponent moves.

The AI also intentionally introduces small aim and movement variations. Its facing direction contains controlled random motion, so its aim is not perfectly identical every frame.

Its movement contains momentum-like behavior. When it has been moving in a useful direction for a while, it can accumulate enough momentum in that direction to trigger a stronger side movement or repositioning maneuver.

The AI periodically rerolls some of its movement and aiming parameters. This changes the exact timing, angle, jitter, and footwork pattern, making the behavior less repetitive.

When the opponent gets close enough, the AI activates its weapon and attempts to attack.

Overall, the behavior is:

Observe opponent → track movement → predict future position → evaluate surrounding space → choose a combat direction → reposition around the opponent → adjust aim → attack when close → repeat continuously.

The AI is not actually learning. It does not remember that a certain opponent beat one of its techniques and then permanently change its strategy. Its variety comes mainly from prediction, short-horizon directional evaluation, predefined behaviors, state changes, and weighted randomness.

Its fighting style can therefore be described as:

Aggressive + predictive + evasive + circling + randomized + short-term tactical.

local function getStuff()

	return folder,
		folder:FindFirstChild("Zombies"),
		folder:FindFirstChild("CurrentMap")
end

	local _, _, map = getStuff()

	if not map then
		return false
	end

	return #map:GetChildren() == 0
end

	for _, thing in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if (thing:IsA("Seat") or thing:IsA("VehicleSeat"))
			and not thing.Disabled
			and thing.Occupant == nil then
			return thing
		end
	end
end

		return

		return

	if not zombies or #zombies:GetChildren() > 0 then
		return
	end

	sitting = true

	task.spawn(function()
		for i = 1, 30 do
			if not seatOn or not mapEmpty() then
				break
			end

			local _, currentZombies = getStuff()

			if currentZombies and #currentZombies:GetChildren() > 0 then
				break
			end

			local character = player.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local seat = getSeat()

			if humanoid and root and seat then
				if humanoid.SeatPart == seat then
					break
				end

				root.CFrame = seat.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)

				task.wait(0.1)

				if not humanoid.SeatPart and not seat.Occupant then
					seat:Sit(humanoid)
				end

				task.wait(0.1)

				if humanoid.SeatPart == seat then
					break
				end
			end

			task.wait(0.1)
		end

		sitting = false
	end)
end

		if not seatOn then
			return

			and #map:GetChildren() == 0 then

	zombies.ChildRemoved:Connect(check)

end)

scripts.script:
--[[
    Animation Control Center
    LocalScript
    Place in: StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

    Features:
    • Disable non-walking animations
    • Walking/running animations remain enabled
    • Draggable GUI
    • Minimize / close
    • Control / Settings / Appearance / Hotkeys / About tabs
    • Multiple themes
    • UI scaling
    • Custom GUI hotkey
    • Notifications
    • Auto-disable non-walking animations on respawn
    • Stop current non-walking animations
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--==================================================
-- SETTINGS
--==================================================

local Settings = {
	NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled = false,
	Theme = "Dark",
	UIScale = 1,
	Keybind = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
	Notifications = true,
	AutoDisableOnSpawn = false,
}

--==================================================
-- THEMES
--==================================================

local Themes = {
	Dark = {
		Background = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 23),
		Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 32),
		Card = Color3.fromRGB(31, 31, 40),
		Accent = Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 255),
		Accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 170, 255),
		Text = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245),
		SubText = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 175),
		Border = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 70),
		Danger = Color3.fromRGB(230, 75, 75),
		Success = Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 120),
	},

	Blue = {
		Background = Color3.fromRGB(12, 22, 38),
		Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(18, 32, 52),
		Card = Color3.fromRGB(25, 43, 68),
		Accent = Color3.fromRGB(40, 140, 255),
		Accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 175, 255),
		Text = Color3.fromRGB(235, 245, 255),
		SubText = Color3.fromRGB(150, 180, 210),
		Border = Color3.fromRGB(45, 75, 110),
		Danger = Color3.fromRGB(235, 80, 80),
		Success = Color3.fromRGB(70, 210, 130),
	},

	Purple = {
		Background = Color3.fromRGB(25, 15, 35),
		Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(37, 22, 52),
		Card = Color3.fromRGB(48, 29, 66),
		Accent = Color3.fromRGB(155, 85, 255),
		Accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(185, 125, 255),
		Text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 238, 255),
		SubText = Color3.fromRGB(180, 160, 200),
		Border = Color3.fromRGB(75, 50, 95),
		Danger = Color3.fromRGB(235, 80, 100),
		Success = Color3.fromRGB(75, 210, 135),
	},

	Green = {
		Background = Color3.fromRGB(12, 28, 22),
		Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(18, 42, 32),
		Card = Color3.fromRGB(25, 55, 42),
		Accent = Color3.fromRGB(50, 200, 120),
		Accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 230, 155),
		Text = Color3.fromRGB(235, 255, 245),
		SubText = Color3.fromRGB(155, 195, 175),
		Border = Color3.fromRGB(45, 85, 65),
		Danger = Color3.fromRGB(235, 80, 80),
		Success = Color3.fromRGB(65, 220, 130),
	},
}

local CurrentTheme = Themes[Settings.Theme]

--==================================================
-- HELPERS
--==================================================

local function tween(object, properties, duration)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(
		duration or 0.2,
		Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
		Enum.EasingDirection.Out
	)

	TweenService:Create(object, info, properties):Play()
end

local function round(object, radius)
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 8)
	corner.Parent = object
	return corner
end

local function addStroke(object, color, thickness)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Color = color
	s.Thickness = thickness or 1
	s.Transparency = 0.3
	s.Parent = object
	return s
end

local function create(className, properties, parent)
	local object = Instance.new(className)

	for property, value in pairs(properties or {}) do
		object[property] = value
	end

	object.Parent = parent
	return object
end

--==================================================
-- CHARACTER HELPERS
--==================================================

local animationConnection
local characterConnection

local function getCharacter()
	return player.Character
end

local function getHumanoid()
	local character = getCharacter()

	if not character then
		return nil
	end

	return character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function getAnimator()
	local humanoid = getHumanoid()

	if not humanoid then
		return nil
	end

	return humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
end

--==================================================
-- WALK/RUN DETECTION
--==================================================

local function animationObjectMatchesTrack(animationObject, track)
	if not animationObject:IsA("Animation") then
		return false
	end

	if not track.Animation then
		return false
	end

	if animationObject.AnimationId == "" then
		return false
	end

	return animationObject.AnimationId == track.Animation.AnimationId
end

local function isDefaultMovementAnimation(track)
	local character = getCharacter()

	if not character then
		return false
	end

	local animate = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")

	if not animate then
		return false
	end

	-- Roblox default walking animations
	local walkFolder = animate:FindFirstChild("walk")

	if walkFolder then
		for _, object in ipairs(walkFolder:GetDescendants()) do
			if animationObjectMatchesTrack(object, track) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	-- Roblox default running animations
	local runFolder = animate:FindFirstChild("run")

	if runFolder then
		for _, object in ipairs(runFolder:GetDescendants()) do
			if animationObjectMatchesTrack(object, track) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

local function isWalkingAnimation(track)
	local name = string.lower(track.Name or "")

	-- Common names used by custom animation systems.
	if string.find(name, "walk", 1, true) then
		return true
	end

	if string.find(name, "run", 1, true) then
		return true
	end

	-- Check Roblox's Animate script.
	if isDefaultMovementAnimation(track) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--==================================================
-- ANIMATION CONTROL
--==================================================

local function stopNonWalkingAnimations()
	local animator = getAnimator()

	if not animator then
		return
	end

	for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
		if not isWalkingAnimation(track) then
			pcall(function()
				track:Stop(0)
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function disconnectAnimationListener()
	if animationConnection then
		animationConnection:Disconnect()
		animationConnection = nil
	end
end

local function connectAnimationListener()
	disconnectAnimationListener()

	local animator = getAnimator()

	if not animator then
		return
	end

	animationConnection = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
		if not Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled then
			return
		end

		if isWalkingAnimation(track) then
			return
		end

		task.defer(function()
			if Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled then
				pcall(function()
					track:Stop(0)
				end)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local function disableNonWalkingAnimations()
	Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled = true

	stopNonWalkingAnimations()
	connectAnimationListener()
end

local function enableAllAnimations()
	Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled = false

	disconnectAnimationListener()
end

local function toggleNonWalkingAnimations()
	if Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled then
		enableAllAnimations()
	else
		disableNonWalkingAnimations()
	end
end

--==================================================
-- GUI
--==================================================

local gui = create("ScreenGui", {
	Name = "AnimationControlCenter",
	ResetOnSpawn = false,
	ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
}, playerGui)

local main = create("Frame", {
	Name = "Main",
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(650, 430),
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -325, 0.5, -215),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Background,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
	ClipsDescendants = true,
}, gui)

round(main, 14)
addStroke(main, CurrentTheme.Border, 1)

local uiScale = create("UIScale", {
	Scale = Settings.UIScale,
}, main)

--==================================================
-- TOP BAR
--==================================================

local topBar = create("Frame", {
	Name = "TopBar",
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, main)

local title = create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 350, 0, 25),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 7),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "Animation Control Center",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextSize = 18,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, topBar)

local subtitle = create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 350, 0, 18),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(21, 32),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "Walking animations stay active",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText,
	Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	TextSize = 10,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, topBar)

local minimizeButton = create("TextButton", {
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, 10),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Card,
	Text = "−",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextSize = 22,
	AutoButtonColor = false,
}, topBar)

round(minimizeButton, 8)

local closeButton = create("TextButton", {
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 10),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Card,
	Text = "×",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextSize = 24,
	AutoButtonColor = false,
}, topBar)

round(closeButton, 8)

--==================================================
-- SIDEBAR
--==================================================

local sidebar = create("Frame", {
	Name = "Sidebar",
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 1, -58),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 58),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, main)

create("UIPadding", {
	PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 15),
	PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10),
	PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10),
}, sidebar)

create("UIListLayout", {
	Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
	HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
	SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
}, sidebar)

--==================================================
-- CONTENT
--==================================================

local content = create("Frame", {
	Name = "Content",
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 1, -58),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 58),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Background,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, main)

--==================================================
-- NOTIFICATIONS
--==================================================

local notificationHolder = create("Frame", {
	Name = "Notifications",
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 400),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -330, 0, 15),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, gui)

create("UIListLayout", {
	VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom,
	HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right,
	Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
}, notificationHolder)

local function notify(message, color)
	if not Settings.Notifications then
		return
	end

	local notification = create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 55),
		BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Card,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, notificationHolder)

	round(notification, 10)
	addStroke(notification, color or CurrentTheme.Accent, 1)

	create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = message,
		TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextSize = 13,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	}, notification)

	notification.Position = UDim2.new(1, 30, 0, 0)

	tween(notification, {
		Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	}, 0.25)

	task.delay(2.5, function()
		if notification.Parent then
			tween(notification, {
				Position = UDim2.new(1, 30, 0, 0)
			}, 0.25)

			task.wait(0.3)

			if notification.Parent then
				notification:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end)
end

--==================================================
-- TABS
--==================================================

local tabs = {}
local pages = {}

local function createTab(name, icon)
	local button = create("TextButton", {
		Name = name .. "Tab",
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42),
		BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = icon .. "  " .. name,
		TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextSize = 13,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
	}, sidebar)

	round(button, 8)

	create("UIPadding", {
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 14),
	}, button)

	local page = create("ScrollingFrame", {
		Name = name .. "Page",
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 1, -30),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 15),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ScrollBarThickness = 4,
		ScrollBarImageColor3 = CurrentTheme.Accent,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		Visible = false,
	}, content)

	create("UIListLayout", {
		Padding = UDim.new(0, 12),
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	}, page)

	tabs[name] = button
	pages[name] = page

	return button, page
end

--==================================================
-- UI COMPONENTS
--==================================================

local function createSectionTitle(parent, text)
	return create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = text,
		TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = 16,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	}, parent)
end

local function createCard(parent, height)
	local card = create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height or 70),
		BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Card,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, parent)

	round(card, 10)
	addStroke(card, CurrentTheme.Border, 1)

	return card
end

local function createToggle(parent, titleText, description, initial, callback)
	local card = createCard(parent, 70)

	create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 24),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 10),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = titleText,
		TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextSize = 13,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	}, card)

	create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 25),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 34),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = description,
		TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		TextSize = 10,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextWrapped = true,
	}, card)

	local toggle = create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 28),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -67, 0.5, -14),
		BackgroundColor3 = initial and CurrentTheme.Success or CurrentTheme.Border,
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
	}, card)

	round(toggle, 14)

	local knob = create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22),
		Position = initial
			and UDim2.new(1, -25, 0.5, -11)
			or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -11),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, toggle)

	round(knob, 50)

	local state = initial

	local function setState(value)
		state = value

		tween(toggle, {
			BackgroundColor3 = state
				and CurrentTheme.Success
				or CurrentTheme.Border
		})

		tween(knob, {
			Position = state
				and UDim2.new(1, -25, 0.5, -11)
				or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -11)
		})

		if callback then
			callback(state)
		end
	end

	toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		setState(not state)
	end)

	return card, setState
end

local function createButton(parent, text, callback, color)
	local normalColor = color or CurrentTheme.Accent

	local button = create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50),
		BackgroundColor3 = normalColor,
		Text = text,
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = 13,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
	}, parent)

	round(button, 9)

	button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		tween(button, {
			BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Accent2
		})
	end)

	button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		tween(button, {
			BackgroundColor3 = normalColor
		})
	end)

	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)

	return button
end

--==================================================
-- CONTROL TAB
--==================================================

local controlTab, controlPage = createTab("Control", "●")

createSectionTitle(controlPage, "Animation Control")

local animationCard = createCard(controlPage, 115)

local animationTitle = create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -160, 0, 25),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 12),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "Non-Walking Animation System",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextSize = 15,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, animationCard)

local animationStatus = create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -160, 0, 45),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 42),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "All animations are currently allowed.",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText,
	Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	TextSize = 11,
	TextWrapped = true,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, animationCard)

local animationToggle = create("TextButton", {
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 40),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -135, 0.5, -20),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Accent,
	Text = "BLOCK",
	TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextSize = 12,
	AutoButtonColor = false,
}, animationCard)

round(animationToggle, 8)

local function updateAnimationButton()
	if Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled then
		animationToggle.Text = "ALLOW ALL"
		animationToggle.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Success

		animationStatus.Text =
			"Non-walking animations are blocked.\nWalking and running animations remain active."

		animationStatus.TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Success
	else
		animationToggle.Text = "BLOCK"
		animationToggle.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Accent

		animationStatus.Text =
			"All animations are currently allowed.\nWalking, jumping, idle, emotes, etc. can play."

		animationStatus.TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText
	end
end

animationToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	toggleNonWalkingAnimations()
	updateAnimationButton()

	if Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled then
		notify(
			"Non-walking animations blocked. Walking remains enabled.",
			CurrentTheme.Success
		)
	else
		notify(
			"All animations are allowed again.",
			CurrentTheme.Accent
		)
	end
end)

createButton(controlPage, "Stop Non-Walking Animations Now", function()
	stopNonWalkingAnimations()

	notify(
		"Current non-walking animations stopped.",
		CurrentTheme.Accent
	)
end)

createToggle(
	controlPage,
	"Block Non-Walking Animations",
	"Blocks idle, jump, fall, climb, swim, emotes and other animations while allowing walking/running.",
	Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled,
	function(state)
		if state then
			disableNonWalkingAnimations()
		else
			enableAllAnimations()
		end

		updateAnimationButton()
	end
)

createSectionTitle(controlPage, "Quick Actions")

createButton(controlPage, "Allow All Animations", function()
	enableAllAnimations()
	updateAnimationButton()

	notify(
		"All animations have been enabled.",
		CurrentTheme.Success
	)
end)

--==================================================
-- SETTINGS TAB
--==================================================

local settingsTab, settingsPage = createTab("Settings", "⚙")

createSectionTitle(settingsPage, "General Settings")

createToggle(
	settingsPage,
	"Notifications",
	"Show popup notifications when actions are performed.",
	Settings.Notifications,
	function(state)
		Settings.Notifications = state
	end
)

createToggle(
	settingsPage,
	"Block On Respawn",
	"Automatically block non-walking animations when your character respawns.",
	Settings.AutoDisableOnSpawn,
	function(state)
		Settings.AutoDisableOnSpawn = state
	end
)

local scaleCard = createCard(settingsPage, 75)

create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 25),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 10),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "UI Scale",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
	TextSize = 13,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, scaleCard)

local scaleValue = create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 35),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "100%",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText,
	Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	TextSize = 10,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, scaleCard)

local scaleMinus = create("TextButton", {
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(35, 35),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -85, 0.5, -17),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary,
	Text = "−",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextSize = 18,
	AutoButtonColor = false,
}, scaleCard)

round(scaleMinus, 7)

local scalePlus = create("TextButton", {
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(35, 35),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -45, 0.5, -17),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary,
	Text = "+",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextSize = 18,
	AutoButtonColor = false,
}, scaleCard)

round(scalePlus, 7)

local function updateScale()
	uiScale.Scale = Settings.UIScale
	scaleValue.Text = math.floor(Settings.UIScale * 100) .. "%"
end

scaleMinus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Settings.UIScale = math.max(0.75, Settings.UIScale - 0.05)
	updateScale()
end)

scalePlus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Settings.UIScale = math.min(1.5, Settings.UIScale + 0.05)
	updateScale()
end)

--==================================================
-- APPEARANCE TAB
--==================================================

local appearanceTab, appearancePage = createTab("Appearance", "◆")

createSectionTitle(appearancePage, "Themes")

local themeNames = {
	"Dark",
	"Blue",
	"Purple",
	"Green",
}

for _, themeName in ipairs(themeNames) do
	local theme = Themes[themeName]

	local button = create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 55),
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Card,
		Text = "     " .. themeName,
		TextColor3 = theme.Text,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = 13,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
	}, appearancePage)

	round(button, 9)

	local indicator = create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 35),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Accent,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, button)

	round(indicator, 5)

	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Settings.Theme = themeName
		CurrentTheme = Themes[themeName]

		main.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Background
		content.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Background
		sidebar.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary
		topBar.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary

		title.TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text
		subtitle.TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText

		updateAnimationButton()

		notify(
			"Theme changed to " .. themeName .. ".",
			CurrentTheme.Accent
		)
	end)
end

--==================================================
-- HOTKEY TAB
--==================================================

local hotkeyTab, hotkeyPage = createTab("Hotkeys", "⌨")

createSectionTitle(hotkeyPage, "Keyboard Shortcuts")

local keybindCard = createCard(hotkeyPage, 90)

create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0, 25),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 12),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "Toggle GUI",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
	TextSize = 13,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, keybindCard)

create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0, 25),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 40),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "Press your chosen key to show/hide the interface.",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText,
	Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	TextSize = 10,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, keybindCard)

local keyButton = create("TextButton", {
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 38),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -125, 0.5, -19),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Accent,
	Text = Settings.Keybind.Name,
	TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextSize = 12,
	AutoButtonColor = false,
}, keybindCard)

round(keyButton, 8)

local waitingForKey = false

keyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	waitingForKey = true
	keyButton.Text = "PRESS KEY..."
	keyButton.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Success
end)

--==================================================
-- ABOUT TAB
--==================================================

local aboutTab, aboutPage = createTab("About", "ⓘ")

createSectionTitle(aboutPage, "Animation Control Center")

local aboutCard = createCard(aboutPage, 190)

create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 1, -20),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 10),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text =
		"Client-side animation controller\n\n" ..
		"• Walking animations remain active\n" ..
		"• Running animations remain active\n" ..
		"• Idle animations can be blocked\n" ..
		"• Jump animations can be blocked\n" ..
		"• Fall animations can be blocked\n" ..
		"• Climb animations can be blocked\n" ..
		"• Swim animations can be blocked\n" ..
		"• Emotes and other animation tracks can be blocked\n\n" ..
		"All changes made by this LocalScript affect your local client.",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText,
	Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	TextSize = 12,
	TextWrapped = true,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
}, aboutCard)

--==================================================
-- TAB SWITCHING
--==================================================

local function selectTab(tabName)
	for name, button in pairs(tabs) do
		if name == tabName then
			button.BackgroundTransparency = 0
			button.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Card
			button.TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text
		else
			button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			button.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary
			button.TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText
		end
	end

	for name, page in pairs(pages) do
		page.Visible = name == tabName
	end
end

for name, button in pairs(tabs) do
	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		selectTab(name)
	end)
end

selectTab("Control")

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING
--==================================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

topBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPosition = main.Position

		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not dragging then
		return
	end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		main.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPosition.X.Scale,
			startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPosition.Y.Scale,
			startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- MINIMIZE
--==================================================

local minimized = false
local normalSize = UDim2.fromOffset(650, 430)

minimizeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	minimized = not minimized

	if minimized then
		minimizeButton.Text = "+"
		main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(650, 58)
	else
		minimizeButton.Text = "−"
		main.Size = normalSize
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- CLOSE
--==================================================

closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	main.Visible = false
end)

--==================================================
-- KEYBOARD INPUT
--==================================================

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then
		return
	end

	if waitingForKey then
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			Settings.Keybind = input.KeyCode
			keyButton.Text = input.KeyCode.Name
			keyButton.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Accent

			waitingForKey = false

			notify(
				"GUI keybind changed to " .. input.KeyCode.Name .. ".",
				CurrentTheme.Success
			)
		end

		return
	end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
		if input.KeyCode == Settings.Keybind then
			main.Visible = not main.Visible
		end
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- CHARACTER RESPAWN
--==================================================

if characterConnection then
	characterConnection:Disconnect()
end

characterConnection = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	task.wait(0.5)

	-- The Animator may not exist immediately after spawning.
	local character = player.Character

	if character then
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)

		if humanoid then
			humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
		end
	end

	if Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled
		or Settings.AutoDisableOnSpawn then

		disableNonWalkingAnimations()
		updateAnimationButton()
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- INITIALIZE
--==================================================

updateAnimationButton()
updateScale()

notify(
	"Animation Control Center loaded.",
	CurrentTheme.Success
)

scripts.script:
--[[
    ================================================================================
    BloxStrike - Complete Cheat Script with Auto Fire, Vector Silent Aim, 
                 3rd Person Camera & Anti-Aim (At-Targets Backwards + Pitch Down)
    Documentation / API: https://docs.projectreal.gg/
    ================================================================================
--]]

local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/gen2"))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "BloxStrike",
    Subtitle = "Auto Fire & Vector Silent Aim",
})

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Global Settings Integration
getgenv().ParsaIntegratedSettings = {
    -- Auto Fire Settings
    AutoFireEnabled = true,
    AutoFireDelay = 0.05,
    AutoFireAngleFOV = 15,       -- Векторный FOV (градусы)
    
    -- Silent Aim Settings
    SilentEnabled = true,
    WallCheck = true,
    Wallbang = false,
    HitPart = "Head",
    UseFOV = true,
    FOVRadius = 140,
    FOVColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
    TeamCheck = true,            -- Проверка на свои команды (не стрелять по своим)

    -- Precision Chams, Bullet Tracers & Effects
    ChamsEnabled = true,
    ChamsMode = "Precision Body Chams", -- "Precision Body Chams", "Highlight Chams"
    ChamsColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 41, 116),
    UseTeamColorChams = false,
    ChamsFillTransparency = 0.3,

    BulletTracers = true,
    TracerColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 41, 116),
    TracerDuration = 1.2,

    NightMode = false,
    HitExplosion = true,
    
    -- Visuals & Camera Settings
    ThirdPerson = false,
    ThirdPersonDist = 12,
    HideViewModelInThirdPerson = true, -- Скрывать 1st person оружие в режиме 3 лица
    
    -- Anti-Aim Settings
    AntiAim = false,
    AntiAimPitchMode = "Down",   -- "Down", "Up", "Jitter", "Custom"
    AntiAimAngle = -89,
    AntiAimYawMode = "AtTargets",-- "AtTargets" (СПИНОЙ ИМЕННО К ВРАГУ), "Backwards", "Spinbot", "Jitter", "Sideways", "Off"
    AntiAimSpinSpeed = 15,
    AntiAimDisableOnFire = true,
    IsFiringState = false,
    
    -- ESP Settings
    ESPEnabled = false,
    ESPBoxes = false,
    ESPSkeletons = false,
    ESPNames = false,
    ESPHealth = false,
    ESPDistance = false,
    ESPMaxDistance = 2500,
    BoxColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 186, 186),
    OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15),
    NameColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    DistanceColor = Color3.fromRGB(179, 179, 179)
}

getgenv().ParsaTeamColors = {
    ["Terrorists"] = Color3.fromRGB(204, 170, 80),
    ["Counter-Terrorists"] = Color3.fromRGB(100, 149, 200)
}

getgenv().ParsaSilentTarget = nil
local Settings = getgenv().ParsaIntegratedSettings

-- ==========================================
-- Векторная математика (Vector Math Functions)
-- ==========================================
local VectorMath = {}

function VectorMath.getDirectionUnit(origin: Vector3, target: Vector3): Vector3
    local delta = target - origin
    if delta.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
        return Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
    end
    return delta.Unit
end

function VectorMath.getAngleDegrees(lookVector: Vector3, targetDirUnit: Vector3): number
    local dot = math.clamp(lookVector:Dot(targetDirUnit), -1, 1)
    return math.deg(math.acos(dot))
end

function VectorMath.isInVectorFOV(origin: Vector3, lookVector: Vector3, targetPos: Vector3, maxAngleDeg: number): (boolean, number)
    local dirUnit = VectorMath.getDirectionUnit(origin, targetPos)
    local angleDeg = VectorMath.getAngleDegrees(lookVector, dirUnit)
    return (angleDeg <= maxAngleDeg), angleDeg
end

-- ==========================================
-- Логика Определения Противоположной Команды
-- ==========================================
local function getNormalizedSide(player: Player): string?
    if not player then return nil end

    local ok, teamObj = pcall(function() return player.Team end)
    if ok and teamObj and teamObj.Name then
        local name = teamObj.Name:lower()
        if name:find("counter") or name == "ct" or name:find("blue") or name:find("guard") or name:find("cop") then
            return "CT"
        end
        if name:find("terror") or name == "t" or name:find("red") or name:find("robber") or name:find("inmate") then
            return "T"
        end
    end

    local okC, teamColor = pcall(function() return player.TeamColor end)
    if okC and teamColor then
        local cName = teamColor.Name:lower()
        if cName:find("blue") or cName:find("navy") or cName:find("cyan") then return "CT" end
        if cName:find("red") or cName:find("orange") or cName:find("yellow") or cName:find("brown") then return "T" end
    end

    local char = player.Character
    if char and char.Parent then
        local pName = char.Parent.Name:lower()
        if pName:find("counter") or pName == "ct" then return "CT" end
        if pName:find("terror") or pName == "t" then return "T" end
    end

    local attr = player:GetAttribute("Team") or player:GetAttribute("Side") or (char and (char:GetAttribute("Team") or char:GetAttribute("Side")))
    if attr ~= nil then
        local s = tostring(attr):lower()
        if s:find("counter") or s == "ct" or s == "2" then return "CT" end
        if s:find("terror") or s == "t" or s == "1" then return "T" end
    end

    local val = (char and (char:FindFirstChild("Team") or char:FindFirstChild("Side"))) or player:FindFirstChild("Team") or player:FindFirstChild("Side")
    if val and val:IsA("ValueBase") then
        local s = tostring(val.Value):lower()
        if s:find("counter") or s == "ct" or s == "2" then return "CT" end
        if s:find("terror") or s == "t" or s == "1" then return "T" end
    end

    local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
    if leaderstats then
        local stat = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Team") or leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Side")
        if stat and stat:IsA("ValueBase") then
            local s = tostring(stat.Value):lower()
            if s:find("counter") or s == "ct" or s == "2" then return "CT" end
            if s:find("terror") or s == "t" or s == "1" then return "T" end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function isOppositeTeam(myPlayer: Player, targetPlayer: Player): boolean
    if not myPlayer or not targetPlayer then return false end
    if myPlayer == targetPlayer then return false end

    local mySide = getNormalizedSide(myPlayer)
    local targetSide = getNormalizedSide(targetPlayer)

    if mySide and targetSide then
        return (mySide ~= targetSide)
    end

    local ok1, team1 = pcall(function() return myPlayer.Team end)
    local ok2, team2 = pcall(function() return targetPlayer.Team end)
    if ok1 and ok2 and team1 ~= nil and team2 ~= nil then
        return team1 ~= team2
    end

    local okC1, color1 = pcall(function() return myPlayer.TeamColor end)
    local okC2, color2 = pcall(function() return targetPlayer.TeamColor end)
    if okC1 and okC2 and color1 ~= nil and color2 ~= nil then
        return color1 ~= color2
    end

    return true
end

getgenv().ParsaGetTeam = getNormalizedSide
getgenv().ParsaIsOpposite = isOppositeTeam

local function get_player_team(player: Player): string?
    local side = getNormalizedSide(player)
    if side == "CT" then return "Counter-Terrorists" end
    if side == "T" then return "Terrorists" end
    return nil
end

local function getGuiContainer()
    local container
    pcall(function()
        if typeof(gethui) == "function" then
            container = gethui()
        elseif CoreGui then
            container = CoreGui
        end
    end)
    if not container then
        pcall(function()
            container = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        end)
    end
    return container or Workspace
end

-- ==========================================
-- Спавн 3D Neon Bullet Tracers
-- ==========================================
local function spawnBulletTracer(fromPos: Vector3, toPos: Vector3)
    if not Settings.BulletTracers then return end
    local distance = (toPos - fromPos).Magnitude
    if distance < 0.2 then return end

    local beamPart = Instance.new("Part")
    beamPart.Name = "ParsaBulletTracer"
    beamPart.Anchored = true
    beamPart.CanCollide = false
    beamPart.CastShadow = false
    beamPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    beamPart.Color = Settings.TracerColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 41, 116)
    beamPart.Transparency = 0.15

    beamPart.Size = Vector3.new(0.08, 0.08, distance)
    beamPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(fromPos, toPos) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -distance / 2)
    beamPart.Parent = Workspace

    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(Settings.TracerDuration or 1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    local tween = TweenService:Create(beamPart, tweenInfo, { Transparency = 1 })
    tween:Play()
    tween.Completed:Connect(function() beamPart:Destroy() end)

    task.delay((Settings.TracerDuration or 1.2) + 0.2, function()
        if beamPart and beamPart.Parent then beamPart:Destroy() end
    end)
end

-- ==========================================
-- Спавн Эффекта Взрыва (Hit / Explosion Effect)
-- ==========================================
local function spawnHitExplosion(pos: Vector3)
    if not Settings.HitExplosion or not pos then return end
    pcall(function()
        local exp = Instance.new("Explosion")
        exp.BlastPressure = 0
        exp.BlastRadius = 0
        exp.DestroyColliderRadius = 0
        exp.ExplosionType = Enum.ExplosionType.NoCulling
        exp.Position = pos
        exp.Parent = Workspace

        local shockwave = Instance.new("Part")
        shockwave.Name = "ParsaExplosionShockwave"
        shockwave.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        shockwave.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        shockwave.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)
        shockwave.Transparency = 0.2
        shockwave.Anchored = true
        shockwave.CanCollide = false
        shockwave.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
        shockwave.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
        shockwave.Parent = Workspace

        local shockwaveTween = TweenService:Create(shockwave, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Size = Vector3.new(7, 7, 7),
            Transparency = 1
        })
        shockwaveTween:Play()
        shockwaveTween.Completed:Connect(function() shockwave:Destroy() end)
    end)
end

-- ==========================================
-- Night Bot (Атмосфера Ночного Режима)
-- ==========================================
local function applyNightState()
    if Settings.NightMode then
        Lighting.ClockTime = 0
        Lighting.Brightness = 2
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 90)
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70)
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
        Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0.5
    else
        Lighting.ClockTime = 14
        Lighting.Brightness = 3
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(127, 127, 127)
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- Высокоточные Чамсы Скелета и Тела
-- ==========================================
local partChamsCache = {}
local highlightChamsCache = {}

local function isVisibleBodyPart(part)
    if not part:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
    local name = part.Name:lower()
    if name == "humanoidrootpart" or name == "root" or name == "hitbox" or name == "collision" then
        return false
    end
    if part.Transparency >= 0.99 then return false end
    return true
end

local function updateChams()
    if not Settings.ChamsEnabled then
        for player, partMap in pairs(partChamsCache) do
            for part, adornment in pairs(partMap) do
                if adornment and typeof(adornment) == "Instance" then adornment:Destroy() end
            end
        end
        partChamsCache = {}
        for player, highlight in pairs(highlightChamsCache) do
            if highlight and typeof(highlight) == "Instance" then highlight:Destroy() end
        end
        highlightChamsCache = {}
        return
    end

    for player, partMap in pairs(partChamsCache) do
        if not player or not player.Parent then
            for part, adornment in pairs(partMap) do
                if adornment then adornment:Destroy() end
            end
            partChamsCache[player] = nil
        end
    end
    for player, highlight in pairs(highlightChamsCache) do
        if not player or not player.Parent then
            if highlight then highlight:Destroy() end
            highlightChamsCache[player] = nil
        end
    end

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player == LocalPlayer then continue end
        local char = player.Character
        local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local isDead = char and (char:GetAttribute("Dead") == true or (humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0))
        local allowed = char and not isDead and (not Settings.TeamCheck or isOppositeTeam(LocalPlayer, player))

        if allowed then
            local chamColor = Settings.ChamsColor
            if Settings.UseTeamColorChams then
                local side = getNormalizedSide(player)
                if side == "T" then chamColor = Color3.fromRGB(240, 160, 40)
                elseif side == "CT" then chamColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 140, 240) end
            end

            if Settings.ChamsMode == "Precision Body Chams" then
                if highlightChamsCache[player] then
                    highlightChamsCache[player]:Destroy()
                    highlightChamsCache[player] = nil
                end

                if not partChamsCache[player] then partChamsCache[player] = {} end
                local partMap = partChamsCache[player]

                for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                    if isVisibleBodyPart(child) then
                        local adornment = partMap[child]
                        if not adornment or not adornment.Parent or adornment.Parent ~= child then
                            if adornment then adornment:Destroy() end
                            adornment = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
                            adornment.Name = "Cham_" .. child.Name
                            adornment.AlwaysOnTop = true
                            adornment.ZIndex = 10
                            adornment.Parent = child
                            partMap[child] = adornment
                        end

                        adornment.Adornee = child
                        adornment.Size = child.Size
                        adornment.Color3 = chamColor
                        adornment.Transparency = Settings.ChamsFillTransparency or 0.3
                        adornment.Visible = true
                    end
                end

                for part, adornment in pairs(partMap) do
                    if not part or not part.Parent or part.Parent ~= char then
                        if adornment then adornment:Destroy() end
                        partMap[part] = nil
                    end
                end

            elseif Settings.ChamsMode == "Highlight Chams" then
                if partChamsCache[player] then
                    for part, adornment in pairs(partChamsCache[player]) do
                        if adornment then adornment:Destroy() end
                    end
                    partChamsCache[player] = nil
                end

                local highlight = highlightChamsCache[player]
                if not highlight or not highlight.Parent then
                    highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    highlight.Name = "FatalityChams_" .. player.Name
                    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    highlight.Parent = char
                    highlightChamsCache[player] = highlight
                end

                if highlight.Adornee ~= char then highlight.Adornee = char end
                highlight.Enabled = true
                highlight.FillColor = chamColor
                highlight.OutlineColor = chamColor
                highlight.FillTransparency = Settings.ChamsFillTransparency or 0.4
                highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
            end

        else
            if partChamsCache[player] then
                for part, adornment in pairs(partMap) do
                    if adornment then adornment:Destroy() end
                end
                partChamsCache[player] = nil
            end
            if highlightChamsCache[player] then
                highlightChamsCache[player]:Destroy()
                highlightChamsCache[player] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- Поиск Ближайшего Противника (Противоположная Команда)
-- ==========================================
local function getClosestEnemyPart(): BasePart?
    local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return nil end

    local myPos = root.Position
    local closestDist = math.huge
    local closestPart = nil

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player == LocalPlayer then continue end
        local pChar = player.Character
        if not pChar then continue end

        local humanoid = pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local isDead = pChar:GetAttribute("Dead") == true or (humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0)
        local isInvincible = pChar:GetAttribute("Invincible") == true
        if isDead or isInvincible then continue end
        if pChar.Parent and pChar.Parent.Name == "Debris" then continue end

        -- Атакуем ТОЛЬКО противоположную команду!
        if not isOppositeTeam(LocalPlayer, player) then continue end

        local ePart = pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or pChar:FindFirstChild("Head") or pChar.PrimaryPart
        if ePart then
            local dist = (ePart.Position - myPos).Magnitude
            if dist < closestDist then
                closestDist = dist
                closestPart = ePart
            end
        end
    end

    return closestPart
end

-- ==========================================
-- Интерфейс Пользователя (UI Tabs)
-- ==========================================
local CombatTab = Window:CreateTab({ Name = "Main", Icon = 10734950309 })
local VisualsTab = Window:CreateTab({ Name = "Visuals & Camera", Icon = 10723345474 })

-- Combat Controls
CombatTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Auto Fire",
    CurrentValue = Settings.AutoFireEnabled,
    Callback = function(Value) Settings.AutoFireEnabled = Value end,
})

CombatTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Vector FOV Angle",
    Range = {1, 60},

    {"UpperTorso", "RightUpperArm"}, {"RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm"}, {"RightLowerArm", "RightHand"},
    {"LowerTorso", "LeftUpperLeg"}, {"LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg"}, {"LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot"},
    {"LowerTorso", "RightUpperLeg"}, {"RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg"}, {"RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot"}

local function createESP(player)
    if espInstances[player] then return end
    local objects = {
        BoxOutline = Drawing.new("Square"),
        Box = Drawing.new("Square"),
        Name = Drawing.new("Text"),
        Distance = Drawing.new("Text"),
        HealthOutline = Drawing.new("Square"),
        Health = Drawing.new("Square"),
        Bones = {}
    }
    objects.BoxOutline.Thickness = 2
    objects.BoxOutline.Filled = false
    objects.BoxOutline.Transparency = 0.5
    objects.BoxOutline.Color = Settings.OutlineColor
    
    objects.Box.Thickness = 1
    objects.Box.Filled = false
    objects.Box.Transparency = 1

    objects.Name.Center = true
    objects.Name.Outline = true
    objects.Name.Font = 1
    objects.Name.Size = 13
    objects.Name.Color = Settings.NameColor

    objects.Distance.Center = true
    objects.Distance.Outline = true
    objects.Distance.Font = 1
    objects.Distance.Size = 12
    objects.Distance.Color = Settings.DistanceColor

    objects.HealthOutline.Thickness = 1
    objects.HealthOutline.Filled = true
    objects.HealthOutline.Transparency = 0.5
    objects.HealthOutline.Color = Settings.OutlineColor
    objects.Health.Filled = true
    objects.Health.Transparency = 1

    for i = 1, 15 do
        local boneLine = Drawing.new("Line")
        boneLine.Thickness = 1

        boneLine.Visible = false
        table.insert(objects.Bones, boneLine)
    end
    espInstances[player] = objects
end

local function removeESP(player)
    local objects = espInstances[player]
    if objects then
        for _, obj in pairs(objects) do
            if type(obj) == "table" then
                for _, bone in pairs(obj) do bone:Remove() end
            else
                obj:Remove()
            end
        end
        espInstances[player] = nil
    end
end
getgenv().ParsaRemoveEsp = removeESP

-- Логика Поиска Цели и Векторных Проверок
-- ==========================================
local FOVCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVCircle.Filled = false
FOVCircle.Thickness = 1
FOVCircle.NumSides = 64
FOVCircle.Color = Settings.FOVColor

local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.IgnoreWater = true

local function isVisible(target)
    if Settings.Wallbang then return true end
    if not target or not target.Parent or not Camera then return false end
    
    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = LocalPlayer.Character and { LocalPlayer.Character } or {}
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, target.Position - origin, rayParams)
    if not result then return true end
    local model = result.Instance and result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    return model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) ~= nil
end

local function FindSilentTarget()
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera or not LocalPlayer.Character then 
        getgenv().ParsaSilentTarget = nil 
        return nil
    end
    
    local camPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local lookVec = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
    local screenCenter = Camera.ViewportSize / 2
    local closestDist = math.huge
    local closestPart = nil

    for _, player in next, Players:GetPlayers() do
        if player == LocalPlayer then continue end
        local char = player.Character
        if not char or char:GetAttribute("Dead") or char:GetAttribute("Invincible") then continue end
        if char.Parent and char.Parent.Name == "Debris" then continue end

        -- АТАКА ТОЛЬКО ПРОТИВОПОЛОЖНОЙ КОМАНДЫ
        if Settings.TeamCheck and not isOppositeTeam(LocalPlayer, player) then continue end

        local targetPart = char:FindFirstChild(Settings.HitPart) or char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char.PrimaryPart
        if not targetPart then continue end

        -- Векторная проверка угла (Vector3 & Unit Vector & Dot Product)
        local inVectorFOV, angleDeg = VectorMath.isInVectorFOV(camPos, lookVec, targetPart.Position, Settings.AutoFireAngleFOV)
        
        local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position)
        if onScreen then
            local distFromCenter = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - screenCenter).Magnitude
            local maxRadius = Settings.UseFOV and Settings.FOVRadius or math.huge
            
            if inVectorFOV and distFromCenter <= maxRadius and distFromCenter < closestDist then
                if Settings.Wallbang or isVisible(targetPart) then
                    closestDist = distFromCenter
                    closestPart = targetPart
                end
            end
        end
    end
    getgenv().ParsaSilentTarget = closestPart
    return closestPart
end

local lastFireTime = 0
local function executeAutoFire()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastFireTime < Settings.AutoFireDelay then return end
    lastFireTime = now

    if typeof(isrbxactive) == "function" and isrbxactive() then
        if typeof(mouse1click) == "function" then
            mouse1click()
        elseif typeof(mouse1press) == "function" and typeof(mouse1release) == "function" then

            task.delay(0.02, mouse1release)

    else
        pcall(function()
            local vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")

            end)
        end)
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- Anti-Aim Pitch & Yaw (СПИНОЙ ИМЕННО К ВРАГУ)
-- ==========================================
local originalNeckC0 = nil
local originalWaistC0 = nil
local originalRootC0 = nil
local lastCharAA = nil
local spinAngle = 0

local function getJoints()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return nil, nil, nil, nil end

    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local upperTorso = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    local lowerTorso = char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
    local rootPart = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    local neck = (head and head:FindFirstChild("Neck")) or (upperTorso and upperTorso:FindFirstChild("Neck"))
    local waist = (upperTorso and upperTorso:FindFirstChild("Waist")) or (lowerTorso and lowerTorso:FindFirstChild("Waist"))
    local rootJoint = rootPart and rootPart:FindFirstChild("RootJoint")

    return neck, waist, rootJoint, humanoid
end

local function updateAntiAimState()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end

    if char ~= lastCharAA then
        lastCharAA = char
        originalNeckC0 = nil
        originalWaistC0 = nil
        originalRootC0 = nil
    end

    local neck, waist, rootJoint, humanoid = getJoints()

    if neck and not originalNeckC0 then originalNeckC0 = neck.C0 end
    if waist and not originalWaistC0 then originalWaistC0 = waist.C0 end
    if rootJoint and not originalRootC0 then originalRootC0 = rootJoint.C0 end

    if not Settings.AntiAim then
        if neck and originalNeckC0 then neck.C0 = originalNeckC0 end
        if waist and originalWaistC0 then waist.C0 = originalWaistC0 end
        if rootJoint and originalRootC0 then rootJoint.C0 = originalRootC0 end
        if humanoid then humanoid.AutoRotate = true end
        return
    end

    if humanoid then humanoid.AutoRotate = false end

    -- Если включена пауза при стрельбе и идет выстрел, выпрямляем персонажа
    if Settings.AntiAimDisableOnFire and Settings.IsFiringState then
        if neck and originalNeckC0 then neck.C0 = originalNeckC0 end
        if waist and originalWaistC0 then waist.C0 = originalWaistC0 end
        if rootJoint and originalRootC0 then rootJoint.C0 = originalRootC0 end
        return
    end

    -- Находим противника из противоположной команды
    local enemyPart = getgenv().ParsaSilentTarget or getClosestEnemyPart()
    local rootPart = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    -- Динамически разворачиваем персонажа СПИНОЙ ИМЕННО К ПОЗИЦИИ ВРАГА!
    if rootPart then
        local myPos = rootPart.Position
        local enemyPos = enemyPart and enemyPart.Position

        if enemyPos then
            local delta = Vector3.new(enemyPos.X - myPos.X, 0, enemyPos.Z - myPos.Z)
            if delta.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                -- Лицом от врага -> СПИНА НАПРАВЛЕНА ПРЯМО НА ВРАГА
                rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myPos, myPos - delta.Unit)
            end
        elseif Camera then
            local lookDir = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
            local flatLook = Vector3.new(lookDir.X, 0, lookDir.Z)
            if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myPos, myPos - flatLook.Unit)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Расчет Pitch
    local pitchRad = 0
    local pitchMode = Settings.AntiAimPitchMode or "Down"
    if pitchMode == "Down" then
        pitchRad = math.rad(-89)
    elseif pitchMode == "Up" then
        pitchRad = math.rad(89)
    elseif pitchMode == "Jitter" then
        pitchRad = math.rad(math.random() > 0.5 and -89 or 89)
    elseif pitchMode == "Custom" then
        pitchRad = math.rad(Settings.AntiAimAngle or -89)
    end

    -- Расчет Yaw
    local yawRad = 0
    local yawMode = Settings.AntiAimYawMode or "AtTargets"
    if yawMode == "Spinbot" then
        spinAngle = (spinAngle + (Settings.AntiAimSpinSpeed or 15)) % 360
        yawRad = math.rad(spinAngle)
    elseif yawMode == "Jitter" then
        yawRad = math.rad(math.random() > 0.5 and 90 or -90)
    elseif yawMode == "Sideways" then
        yawRad = math.rad(90)
    elseif yawMode == "Backwards" then
        yawRad = math.pi
    end

    -- Применяем CFrame к суставам
    if neck and originalNeckC0 then
        neck.C0 = originalNeckC0 * CFrame.Angles(pitchRad, yawRad, 0)
    end

    if waist and originalWaistC0 then
        waist.C0 = originalWaistC0 * CFrame.Angles(pitchRad * 0.4, 0, 0)
    end

    if rootJoint and originalRootC0 and yawMode == "Spinbot" then
        rootJoint.C0 = originalRootC0 * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, yawRad)
    elseif rootJoint and originalRootC0 then
        rootJoint.C0 = originalRootC0
    end
end

local function setViewModelVisibility(visible: boolean)
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local targetAlpha = visible and 0 or 1

    if Camera then
        for _, child in ipairs(Camera:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("Folder") or child:IsA("BasePart") or child.Name:lower():find("view") or child.Name:lower():find("arm") or child.Name:lower():find("gun") then
                for _, part in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        part.LocalTransparencyModifier = targetAlpha
                        part.Transparency = targetAlpha
                    elseif part:IsA("Decal") or part:IsA("Texture") then
                        part.Transparency = targetAlpha
                    end
                end
                if child:IsA("BasePart") then
                    child.LocalTransparencyModifier = targetAlpha
                    child.Transparency = targetAlpha
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, child in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        local n = child.Name:lower()
        if (n:find("viewmodel") or n == "vmodel" or n:find("fps")) and (child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("Folder") or child:IsA("BasePart")) then
            for _, part in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.LocalTransparencyModifier = targetAlpha
                    part.Transparency = targetAlpha
                elseif part:IsA("Decal") or part:IsA("Texture") then
                    part.Transparency = targetAlpha
                end
            end
            if child:IsA("BasePart") then
                child.LocalTransparencyModifier = targetAlpha
                child.Transparency = targetAlpha
            end
        end
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char then
        for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            local n = child.Name:lower()
            if (n:find("viewmodel") or n == "vmodel" or n:find("fps")) and (child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("Folder")) then
                for _, part in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        part.LocalTransparencyModifier = targetAlpha
                        part.Transparency = targetAlpha
                    elseif part:IsA("Decal") or part:IsA("Texture") then
                        part.Transparency = targetAlpha
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- 3rd Person View Logic
-- ==========================================
local lastThirdPersonState = false
local originalMinZoom = 0.5
local originalMaxZoom = 128

local function updateThirdPersonState()
    if not LocalPlayer then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

    if Settings.ThirdPerson then
        local dist = Settings.ThirdPersonDist or 12
        LocalPlayer.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
        LocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = dist
        LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = dist

        if char and Camera then
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if head then
                for _, descendant in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                        descendant.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                    end
                end

                if Settings.HideViewModelInThirdPerson then
                    setViewModelVisibility(false)
                end

                local focusPos = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
                local lookDir = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
                local targetCamPos = focusPos - (lookDir * dist)

                local tpRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
                tpRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                tpRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }

                local hitResult = Workspace:Raycast(focusPos, -lookDir * dist, tpRayParams)
                if hitResult then
                    targetCamPos = hitResult.Position + (lookDir * 0.5)
                end

                Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetCamPos, focusPos)
            end
        end
        lastThirdPersonState = true
    else
        if lastThirdPersonState then
            LocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = originalMinZoom
            LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = originalMaxZoom
            setViewModelVisibility(true)
            lastThirdPersonState = false
        end
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- Главный Цикл Рендера (RenderStepped Loop)
-- ==========================================
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera then return end
    
    -- Отрисовка FOV
    FOVCircle.Visible = Settings.UseFOV
    if FOVCircle.Visible then
        FOVCircle.Position = Camera.ViewportSize / 2
        FOVCircle.Radius = Settings.FOVRadius
        FOVCircle.Color = Settings.FOVColor
    end

    -- Обновление вида от 3 лица
    updateThirdPersonState()

    -- Поиск цели
    local target = FindSilentTarget()

    -- Auto Fire выстрел
    if Settings.AutoFireEnabled and target then
        Settings.IsFiringState = true
        executeAutoFire()
    else
        Settings.IsFiringState = false
    end

    -- Обновление Anti-Aim (СПИНОЙ ИМЕННО К БЛИЖАЙШЕМУ ВРАГУ)
    updateAntiAimState()

    -- Обновление Чамсов
    updateChams()

    -- Обновление Ночного Режима (Night Bot)
    applyNightState()

    -- ESP обновление игроков
    local camPos = Camera.CFrame.Position

    for _, player in next, Players:GetPlayers() do
        local objects = espInstances[player]
        if player == LocalPlayer then 
            if objects then removeESP(player) end
            continue 
        end

        local char = player.Character
        local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local rootPart = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char.PrimaryPart)
        
        local isDead = char and (char:GetAttribute("Dead") == true or (humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0))
        
        local allowed = Settings.ESPEnabled and char and rootPart and not isDead
        if allowed and (camPos - rootPart.Position).Magnitude > Settings.ESPMaxDistance then allowed = false end

        if not allowed then
            if objects then
                for _, obj in pairs(objects) do if type(obj) ~= "table" then obj.Visible = false end end
                for _, bone in pairs(objects and objects.Bones or {}) do bone.Visible = false end
            end
            continue
        end

        if not objects then
            createESP(player)
            objects = espInstances[player]
        end

        local playerTeam = get_player_team(player)
        local targetColor = Settings.BoxColor
        if playerTeam and getgenv().ParsaTeamColors[playerTeam] then
            targetColor = getgenv().ParsaTeamColors[playerTeam]
        end

        local rootPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPart.Position)
        if onScreen then
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local headPos = head and Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position) or Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
            local legPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
            
            local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - legPos.Y)
            local width = height / 1.6
            local boxX = rootPos.X - (width / 2)
            local boxY = headPos.Y
            
            objects.Box.Visible = Settings.ESPBoxes
            objects.BoxOutline.Visible = Settings.ESPBoxes
            if Settings.ESPBoxes then
                local size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                local pos = Vector2.new(boxX, boxY)
                objects.Box.Size = size
                objects.Box.Position = pos
                objects.Box.Color = targetColor
                objects.BoxOutline.Size = size
                objects.BoxOutline.Position = pos
            end

            local isR15 = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") ~= nil
            local activeBoneMap = isR15 and BONE_MAP_R15 or BONE_MAP_R6
            
            for i, boneLine in ipairs(objects.Bones) do
                local connection = activeBoneMap[i]
                if Settings.ESPSkeletons and connection then
                    local partA = char:FindFirstChild(connection[1])
                    local partB = char:FindFirstChild(connection[2])
                    if partA and partB then
                        local posA, visA = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(partA.Position)
                        local posB, visB = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(partB.Position)
                        if visA and visB then
                            boneLine.From = Vector2.new(posA.X, posA.Y)
                            boneLine.To = Vector2.new(posB.X, posB.Y)
                            boneLine.Color = targetColor
                            boneLine.Visible = true
                        else boneLine.Visible = false end
                    else boneLine.Visible = false end
                else boneLine.Visible = false end
            end

            if Settings.ESPNames then
                objects.Name.Text = player.Name
                objects.Name.Position = Vector2.new(rootPos.X, boxY - 15)
                objects.Name.Visible = true
            else objects.Name.Visible = false end

            if Settings.ESPDistance then
                local distance = math.floor((camPos - rootPart.Position).Magnitude)
                objects.Distance.Text = tostring(distance) .. "m"
                objects.Distance.Position = Vector2.new(rootPos.X, boxY + height + 2)
                objects.Distance.Visible = true
            else objects.Distance.Visible = false end

            if Settings.ESPHealth and humanoid then
                local barPadding, barWidth = 4, 2
                local barX = boxX - barPadding - barWidth
                local healthPercentage = math.clamp(humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                local healthHeight = height * healthPercentage

                objects.Health.Color = Color3.fromHex("#32CD32"):Lerp(Color3.fromHex("#FF0000"), 1 - healthPercentage)
                objects.HealthOutline.Position = Vector2.new(barX - 1, boxY - 1)
                objects.HealthOutline.Size = Vector2.new(barWidth + 2, height + 2)
                objects.Health.Position = Vector2.new(barX, boxY + (height - healthHeight))
                objects.Health.Size = Vector2.new(barWidth, healthHeight)
                objects.Health.Visible = true
                objects.HealthOutline.Visible = true
            else
                objects.Health.Visible = false
                objects.HealthOutline.Visible = false
            end
        else
            for _, obj in pairs(objects) do if type(obj) ~= "table" then obj.Visible = false end end
            for _, bone in pairs(objects.Bones) do bone.Visible = false end
        end
    end
end)
